subject: res-ci-infrastructure
text: - **CI infrastructure:** GitHub environments "Signed Builds" and "WPT" (.github/workflows/publish-browser.yml:41; .github/workflows/wpt.yml:106); WPT runner label `warp-ubuntu-latest-arm64-16x` with rust-cache provider "warpbuild" (.github/workflows/wpt.yml:27; .github/workflows/wpt.yml:32-38) — all reached only from `DioxusLabs/blitz`: every job that uses them (`release-cli`, `wpt`, `trigger-archive`, `post-results`) carries `github.repository == 'DioxusLabs/blitz'` in its `if`, so no fork ref reaches them (.github/workflows/publish-browser.yml:37; .github/workflows/wpt.yml:26; .github/workflows/wpt.yml:103; .github/workflows/wpt-post-results.yml:15); the fork's GitHub Actions cache (10 GB per-repository budget, least-recently-used eviction): the test job saves under `shared-key: workspace-test`, which the `a11y` job and, since 2026-10-14-quality-gates, the `stand-repeat` job restore with `save-if: false`, and `audit` and `coverage` carry no cache step (.github/workflows/ci.yml:86-89; .github/workflows/ci.yml:256-259; .github/workflows/ci.yml:300-323); after the first run on a re-keyed lockfile it held 12 entries, 10 723 071 252 B — over the budget — with the `workspace-test` entry (1 006 409 498 B, restored once by `a11y`) and clippy's already evicted, while two pre-re-key matrix entries (≈ 2.16 GB) stood beside their re-keyed twins: a `Cargo.lock` change re-mints every key and evicts until the old keys age out — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-05-ci-gate-legs/evidence/ci-run.md (`gh cache list`, 2026-10-05, after CI run 37386253475)

subject: crosscut-config-management
text: - **Config management:** documents are configured through the `DocumentConfig` struct (packages/blitz-dom/src/config.rs:31-74); optional capabilities are compile-time Cargo features, each dioxus-native feature forwarding to the same-named feature of the underlying blitz crates, and `accessibility` also to `dioxus-native-dom/accessibility`, which enables dioxus-native-dom's own optional `accesskit` and gates its `accessibility_tree` override and its `snapshot`, `snapshot_diff`, `snapshot_text` and `actionable` modules (packages/dioxus-native/Cargo.toml:16-33; packages/dioxus-native-dom/Cargo.toml:15-23; packages/dioxus-native-dom/Cargo.toml:41), with feature-gated code in the apps (apps/browser/src/main.rs:23-24; apps/browser/src/toolbar.rs:214-257; apps/browser/src/toolbar.rs:277-311); launch configs are `Box<dyn Any>` values downcast at launch (packages/dioxus-native/src/lib.rs:114-145); platform behavior is gated with `cfg(target_os = ...)` and an `IS_MOBILE` const (apps/browser/src/main.rs:48; apps/browser/src/main.rs:79-89; apps/browser/src/tab_strip.rs:9-12); on `wasm32` system-font discovery is disabled and `build_single_font_ctx` is the standard WASM setup (packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:434-437; packages/blitz-dom/src/lib.rs:134-139); runtime inputs are CLI arguments and environment variables (see Occupied Resources)

subject: crosscut-logging-and-timing
text:
- **Logging and timing:** `tracing`, `tracing-subscriber` and `tracing-log` are workspace dependencies (Cargo.toml:188-190); escher binaries install `escher_telemetry::init(escher_telemetry::service_identity!())` at start — today the two binaries of the seven_guis package, which therefore both stamp `service.name=seven_guis`: `seven_guis_native`, unconditionally on the native target, before `dioxus_native::launch`, and the session host `escher-session`, first thing in its native `main`, each reporting an `Err` with `eprintln!` and continuing (examples/seven_guis/src/main.rs:4-10; examples/seven_guis/src/session_host.rs:20-22) — which builds a `Registry` with an `EnvFilter` and one non-ANSI fmt layer using the escher formatter (tracing-subscriber features env-filter · fmt · registry · std · tracing-log) — stated once, in the private `sink_layer`, which since 2026-10-07-driver-command-spans sets `with_span_events(FmtSpan::CLOSE)` and the crate-private field formatter `SpanFields`, so the layer prints a closed span's line beside an event's (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-09 — §Standard Contracts → Telemetry bootstrap) — writes to stderr only, stamps `service.name` / `service.version` on every line, bridges `log` records, drops every record whose target is outside the engine and escher prefix sets (`ENGINE_TARGET_PREFIXES`, `ESCHER_TARGET_PREFIXES`) at every level and whatever `RUST_LOG` names, scrubs the records that print — a closed span's fields by the rule that judges an event's — and chains the panic hook — no filter layer is added, the drop sits in the formatter (packages/escher-telemetry/Cargo.toml:13-16; packages/escher-telemetry/src/lib.rs:102-163; packages/escher-telemetry/src/format.rs:134-178);
 escher-driver emits its command span and, since 2026-10-10-mcp-surface, its `tool_call` span through `tracing` ungated and installs no subscriber (packages/escher-driver/src/execute.rs:96-111); the upstream `tracing_subscriber::fmt::init()` installs run only under the `tracing` feature and write to stdout unscrubbed (apps/browser/src/main.rs:73-74; apps/readme/src/main.rs:76-77; examples/todomvc/src/main.rs:16-17); tracing is an optional feature forwarded down the crate chain (packages/blitz-html/Cargo.toml:15; packages/blitz-net/Cargo.toml:18; packages/blitz-paint/Cargo.toml:15; packages/blitz-shell/Cargo.toml:21; packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/document.rs:256-257; packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/runtime.rs:1104-1105; packages/blitz/src/lib.rs:48-49); the WPT runner uses the `log` facade with `env_logger::init()` (wpt/runner/src/main.rs:23; wpt/runner/src/main.rs:464; wpt/runner/src/net_provider.rs:3); frame and phase time logging are opt-in features `log-frame-times`, `log-phase-times` (Cargo.toml:265-268), resolve phases timed with `debug_timer!` (packages/blitz-dom/src/resolve.rs:77; packages/blitz-dom/src/resolve.rs:169); `screenshot` times phases with a `Timer` printing `"{message} in {diff}ms"` (examples/screenshot.rs:186-215; examples/screenshot.rs:56; examples/screenshot.rs:146); `paint_bench` runs 5 warmup iterations (examples/paint_bench.rs:26; examples/paint_bench.rs:39-50)

subject: crosscut-service-wiring
text: - **Service wiring:** a `shell_provider` handles redraw, clipboard and file dialogs (packages/blitz-dom/src/scrolling.rs:320; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:61; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:928); a `navigation_provider` receives link-click navigations (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:893-897); redraws are requested through `ShellProvider::request_redraw` after mutations, resource loads, hover, device changes and a focus set or cleared, the Tab key asking for none of its own (packages/blitz-dom/src/mutator.rs:76-78; packages/blitz-dom/src/net.rs:124; packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:2108; packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:2288; packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:1852; packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:1911-1915); redraw is skipped while critical resources are pending or the window is occluded (packages/blitz-shell/src/window.rs:418-439; packages/blitz-shell/src/window.rs:600-605; packages/blitz-paint/src/render.rs:176-178); dioxus services are provided as root contexts — net provider, HTML parser provider, native document, window event handlers, shell provider, history, renderer, winit window (packages/dioxus-native/src/lib.rs:181-205; packages/dioxus-native/src/dioxus_application.rs:147-172) — and apps use `use_context_provider` / `use_context` (apps/browser/src/main.rs:121-123; apps/browser/src/tab.rs:200; apps/browser/src/toolbar.rs:46); the blitz document is shared as `Rc<RefCell<BaseDocument>>` (packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/dioxus_document.rs:70; packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/events.rs:140-144); JS shared state is `Rc<RefCell<…>>` in a `DomCtx` on the Boa context (packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/state.rs:130-148; packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/dom/mod.rs:36-43); window event handlers live in a `SlotMap` applied per window id (packages/dioxus-native/src/event_handlers.rs:25-63; packages/dioxus-native/src/dioxus_application.rs:197-199)

subject: crosscut-event-processing
text: - **Event processing:** default-action events are queued and processed in order, each running handlers then its default action unless cancelled (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/driver.rs:352-359; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/driver.rs:423-426); events for sub-documents and custom widgets are forwarded with adjusted coordinates (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/mod.rs:18-27; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/mod.rs:125-180); focused text inputs are re-clamped to keep the caret visible (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/mod.rs:112-123; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/mod.rs:311-318); dioxus skips event kinds with zero handlers (packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/dioxus_document.rs:326-332; packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/mutation_writer.rs:349-359); `mounted` listeners fire after `initial_build` and each `poll` (packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/mutation_writer.rs:331-336; packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/dioxus_document.rs:144-152; packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/dioxus_document.rs:216-236); JS microtasks drained after eval, timers and event dispatch (packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/runtime.rs:1458-1476; packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/runtime.rs:1639; packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/runtime.rs:1690-1692); style and layout resolved before JS geometry, hit-test, selection and computed-style reads (packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/dom/element.rs:1023-1037; packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/dom/document.rs:326-331; packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/dom/style.rs:80-84); keyboard shortcuts use Cmd on macOS and Ctrl elsewhere (apps/browser/src/tab_strip.rs:42-56; apps/browser/src/util.rs:4-12)
